nodes.title: Building New Marsh on the Coast
nodes.why: The K-12 station itself; a run that does not pass goes back to the brief.

nodes.title: Check question — Building New Marsh on the Coast
nodes.why: One question on the idea just taught. A missed answer goes to a simpler re-teach step, then back here. Never scored against anyone.

check.q: The pump crew signals a pause while they move the end of the pipe. What do you do?
options: Step back from the dike rail and wait until the crew lead says to go on.
check.why: When the crew moves the pipe, everyone nearby steps back and waits.

nodes.title: Re-teach — Building New Marsh on the Coast, one step at a time
nodes.why: The adaptive step: the same idea in the station's own short step titles, then back to the check.

reteach: Find what makes a marsh lose ground.
Stay on the dike with the crew lead.
Put the marsh-building steps in order.

nodes.title: End-of-lesson check-in
nodes.why: The lesson closes on the learner's own answer about how it went, not on a score.
